cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Comfort Everyone Else
cards.instruction: Meet every painful moment by comforting someone else more intensely while your own distress becomes harder to hide.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I've brought tissues. Being laid off together doesn't make your day any easier.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're wiping your eyes on your sleeve.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I'm saving the soft ones for you. Tell me what you're worried about.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You. You can't even get the tissue box open.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then take the whole box. I'll make tea once my hands stop doing this.

mechanism: A directs the other person's care while A's own visible distress defeats increasingly ambitious comfort.
confusable: Unlike requesting support, A rejects attention to A and commands comfort toward B under claimed authority.
comparison: Tissues and shaking after shared layoffs differ from feeding someone after choir rejection.
seedUse: The seed already directs B's worries and gives over the box; S01's dismissal of scrutiny reinforces that controlling care.
